lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a linear fashion along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical columns of spots intersecting with horizontal rows to create a distinct grid-like pattern of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge line running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the ridge to shadow directly below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 4 to 6 distinct high-luminance blobs scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin.
